top_signals.title: CNBC Daily Open: U.S.-China meeting in focus while Trump wants to rename the Strait of Hormuz
top_signals.summary: All eyes are on the upcoming meeting between U.S. President Donald Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping at the White House, which could offer more clues to the U.S.-China trade relations as well as China's stance towards Iran amid the Mideast conflict.
